name: Heart's Refuge - Spring
source:
Heart's Refuge is a kinetic story heavily inspired by my current modded Stardew Valley game. I wanted to create a visual version of my take on the game and show insights from the main character as she goes through the transition from her hectic impersonal city life to peaceful, friendly Pelican Town.

[From [url=https://nightfable.itch.io/heartsrefuge]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《心灵避风港》是一部深受我近期游玩的《星露谷物语》模组档启发的单线视觉小说。我希望将自己对这款游戏的诠释以视觉小说的形式呈现出来，细腻展现女主角告别繁忙冷漠的都市生活、融入宁静友善的鹈鹕镇的心路历程。

[摘自[url=https://nightfable.itch.io/heartsrefuge]itch.io[/url]]
